I replied to Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message. The main contact for the door 6 duplicate arrivals at Quarrendon Freight Lines is Thea Ramaswell, their Director of Yard Operations.

Two sources Marcus can see himself back that up. Dana posted in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025 that Thea had flagged the duplicate arrivals on door 6 again (morning shift). The public North cheat sheet also lists Thea as the account's main contact.

A contact name is an operational fact, and Marcus is on the North team, so no approval was needed.
